protectedInterfaceOriginal: Smite, Aura, and Lay on Hands are Oath mechanics and do not generate Weave Dissonance. After a successful melee hit, the next Oath spell before the end of the next turn generates 1 less Dissonance.
engine: Charisma governs Oath DC/M and divine technique attacks. Weapon attacks use their ordinary Strength/Dexterity ability. Hit Die d10; all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Paladin has no Conviction or Oracle Revelation Charges. Lay on Hands is its own pool, 5×Paladin level, fully restored only by long rest. Ordinary spells and printed Smite fuel use the same Paladin Core V 2 RP pool; healing points never convert to RP.

Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary 25-card template: at 1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At 2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At 3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At 10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks 11, Final Gift 20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock 3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank 1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at 1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend 1 RP to add S d6 radiant. At 2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath 3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

One Oath aura, requires consciousness and no concentration. Radius 10 ft at 3, 15 ft at 6, 20 ft at 10, 30 ft at 15. Benefits affect up to 3 allies or 3 enemies as the Oath card states, chosen at start of your turn and changed next turn; they must stay within aura. At 6 choose one additional aura benefit for that day: allies+1 saves against fear/charm, or 1 flat DR against weapon damage. At 7 once/short rest when enemy damages an ally in aura, Reaction make one melee attack if in reach; may pay normal Smite cost even off turn, but total Smite maximum one per round from this reactive feature. At 10 aura persists until start of your next regular turn after incapacitation; then ends if still incapacitated. At 15 also grant selected allies+1 initiative while in aura when initiative is rolled; no retroactive turn changes.

At 17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to 3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1 saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current 5 L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at 11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker 20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

The source names a Forbidden Spell List but does not supply five complete entries for each inversion. This pilot explicitly adds one shared five-spell replacement list (below), with each Oathbreaker using its inversion name as flavor. These are new test rules, not recovered historical spells. Choose the normal Oath package OR inverted package at a time. All later Oath prerequisites still use Paladin class level; the Oathbreaker label does not bypass 3/11/20 gates.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

An emergency Reaction whose trigger itself incapacitates you, such as Grace Reversal or Thorn Crown, may resolve before that incapacitation only if you had a Reaction available before the triggering event. This grants no other actions while incapacitated. Narrative labels such as oppressor require a specific act of captivity/coercion established in the scene, not an alignment or identity assumption.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.

For any one damage event choose exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Using it consumes the shared redirection allowance for that round. Crown Undying permits two DIFFERENT ally-damage events per round, but still only one redirection feature may modify each event.
workedExample: Paladin 5 Mercy, STR 16 CHA 16 PB 3 S 2 M 3: RP 6, Lay on Hands 25, two ordinary Attack Action attacks. Aura radius 10 ft until Paladin 6.
Turn 1 Attack Action: first hit permits 2 RP Smite, RP 6→4, adding 3d8 radiant. Second weapon hit receives no second Smite from this activation. Mercy healing uses only its printed bounded rider.
Turn 2 Action Lay on Hands spends 5 points to heal 5 HP, pool 25→20; it does not cost RP or add Dissonance. Bonus Action Protective Stance uses its own short-rest allowance; no free attack.
Turn 3 ordinary Attack Action hits. This primes the protected 1 D reduction for an Oath spell before end next turn; it does not refund 2 RP already spent or remove existing strain.

Turn 4 cast a rank 1 Oath Revelation for its printed 2 RP: RP 4→2 before strain surcharge, base 1 D becomes 0 from the primed hit. If immediately repeating the same spell, its Refrain still contributes after the single 1 D reduction.
At encounter end Lay on Hands remains 20 and RP 2. Short rest Retune restores RP by the shared formula up to 6, but never refills healing pool; long rest restores 25.

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: Choose 1 or more Lay on Hands points, maximum L per Action
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living creature touched
cards.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. Alternatively spend 5 points to end Poisoned or allow one immediate save against an existing disease that permits saves; cannot erase special-quest diseases, Wounds or death. This is finite pool healing, no RP conversion.

source.originalText: Lay on Hands: Healing pool equal to 5 × your Paladin level; can heal or remove conditions.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; 60 ft radius
cards.effect: Know presence, number and direction of celestials, fiends and undead not behind total cover. Does not reveal identity, thoughts, moral alignment or ordinary hidden humanoids. At 18 reveals eligible disguised outsiders through mundane/magical disguises, still no total cover penetration.

source.originalText: Divine Sense: Detect the presence of celestial, fiendish, or undead entities within 60 feet.

cards.name: Martial Proficiency
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self
cards.effect: Proficient with all simple/martial weapons, all armor and shields. Does not grant a second fighting style, extra attack, proficiency in every tool or double armor/shield bonuses.

source.originalText: Martial Proficiency: Proficiency with all armor types, shields, and weapons.

cards.name: Divine Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature you hit
cards.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

cards.name: Protective Stance
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; adjacent ally
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once before end, Reaction interpose for adjacent ally hit by weapon: reduce its damage by S+M and take that much unpreventable damage yourself. Cannot redirect again or create resource/damage triggers. You must remain conscious.

source.originalText: Protective Stance: Enter a defensive posture that increases your AC and allows you to intercept attacks meant for nearby allies.

cards.name: Righteous Challenge
cards.rangeAndTarget: One perceived enemy 30 ft
cards.effect: WIS save; failure disadvantage on attacks against other creatures while it can perceive you. It may move, use nonattack actions or decline attacks; no compelled suicide, belief change or full turn loss.

source.originalText: Righteous Challenge: Mark an enemy, forcing them to focus on you or suffer penalties.

cards.name: Bolstering Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
cards.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

cards.name: Sacred Touch
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living creature touched
cards.effect: Stabilize a living Downed creature at 0 HP without healing; damage/ordinary rules can end stability. Alternatively pay 1 RP and examine 1 minute to learn whether one curse/disease affects it, without revealing origin or cure. No resurrection or free healing.

source.originalText: Sacred Touch: Channel divine energy to stabilize a dying creature or detect the presence of curses and diseases.

cards.name: Aura Scaling
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your one Oath aura
cards.effect: Use exact radius, target cap, secondary benefit, reactive Smite, Aura Surge and Manifestation engine rules. Only chosen Oath aura applies; inverted aura replaces it. Multiple Paladin auras of same name do not stack numeric benefits.

source.originalText:
Aura Scaling
Level 3: 10 ft radius, base aura effect active while conscious
Level 6: 15 ft radius, gains secondary benefit (e.g., DR, saves)
Level 7: 15 ft radius, gain reactive Smite or spell trigger
Level 10: 20 ft radius, aura persists for 1 round if incapacitated
Level 15: 30 ft radius, aura debuffs enemies or buffs allies
Level 17: 30 ft radius, Aura Surge (1/rest) - double aura power or trigger burst effect
Level 20: 30+ ft radius, Divine Manifestation - aura auto-activates on initiative, cannot be suppressed

cards.name: Signature Power (Level 11)
cards.cost: One short-rest use plus printed cost
cards.rangeAndTarget: As chosen Signature
cards.effect: Automatically gain only your Oath's Signature, or corresponding inverted Signature if Oathbreaker. This unlock cannot be spent early as a Base/Arch selection. Rest references mean short rest unless card expressly long rest.

Mercy: Miracle Veil – Heal + Prevent death
Vengeance: Judgment Brand – Doom mark, bonus crit
Dominion: Heaven's Decree – Obey or suffer
Flame: Holy Inferno – AoE Smite purge
Ancients: Thorn Crown – Reflect status
Silence: Vow Unbroken – Bonus Smite if you stay silent
Chain: Warden's Lock – Lock enemies in zone
Grief: Final Vigil – Channel ally's power
Chains Broken: Righteous Quake – Break bindings, AoE push

cards.name: Divine Resistance (Level 13)
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self
cards.effect: Choose fire, necrotic or psychic resistance. Same-type resistance does not stack. This is independent of Aura but does not automatically extend to allies.

source.originalText:
Divine Resistance (Level 13)
Choose one type of damage to gain resistance against: Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic.

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: All remaining Lay on Hands points; minimum 1
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in aura
cards.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. source.originalText:
Lay on Hands: Full Cleansing Wave (Level 17)
Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Divine Sense targets 60 ft
cards.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

cards.name: Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
cards.cost: One long-rest use plus printed cost
cards.rangeAndTarget: As Oath card
cards.effect: Gain only your Oath's Final Gift. Oathbreaker instead gains Black Manifestation below. Do not grant all ten gifts, restore use by switching Oaths, or combine with another Final from different class level.

source.originalText:
Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
Receive the ultimate blessing of your Oath, a powerful capstone ability that represents the pinnacle of your divine connection.

cards.rangeAndTarget: Self

cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius fixed point 30 ft, up to 3 enemies

cards.activation: Reaction after an enemy damages an ally
cards.rangeAndTarget: That enemy 60 ft; one living ally in your aura
cards.effect: New rank 5 Forbidden spell. Enemy WIS save for 3 S d8 necrotic, half success; ally regains S d8 HP after triggering damage. Does not revive dead or undo conditions. Uses ordinary spell strain and your Reaction.

cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
cards.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; up to 3 living allies within 10 feet of you
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Your Oath Smite deals radiant damage instead of adding a second Smite packet. Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger

cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura

value.spell: Sanctify Ground — zone removes conditions each round

cards.rangeAndTarget: One allied corpse in your Oath aura that died since the end of your previous regular turn
cards.frequency: At most once per creature per long rest
cards.effect: Trigger when you are reduced to 0 HP without being killed outright. One eligible allied corpse returns to life at 1 HP. You remain at 0 HP and resolve your own dying state normally. The revived ally retains Wounds and expended resources and must have a body capable of sustaining life. Grace Reversal cannot target you.

cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Apply Miracle Veil to up to 3 allies in your aura without spending its short-rest use or RP. oathCatalog.theme: Mercy is a shelter kept open in the worst hour: protection, healing, and the preservation of life before vengeance can make another wound.
conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

oathCatalog.theme: Vengeance is judgment carried through the long road: fury disciplined into pursuit, execution held to a sworn account, and no refuge promised to the unrepentant.
conductClauses: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

oathCatalog.theme: Authority held as a public burden: law spoken plainly, judgment bound to truth, and rulership measured by the safety it keeps
conductClauses: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

oathCatalog.theme: A fire kept for cleansing rather than hunger: zeal tempered by restraint, corruption confronted, and renewal guarded after the ash
conductClauses: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

oathCatalog.theme: The living memory of the old places: nature guarded as a covenant, ancient power answered with humility, and renewal left possible for those who follow
conductClauses: Protect ancient places and living memory, especially where no living voice remains to speak for them
Do not destroy what cannot be restored; power does not excuse a wound made for haste
Honor pacts with fey and primal spirits, and do not mistake an old promise for permission to command

oathCatalog.theme: Humility, watchful restraint, and strength held in quiet
conductClauses: Speak when words serve the oath; let silence bear the rest
Do not claim glory for the work entrusted to you
Hear the whole matter before you judge it

oathCatalog.theme: A vigil of iron: martyrdom, warding, and the burden freely borne for another
conductClauses: Stand between the helpless and harm, even when the cost is yours to bear
Keep every ward entrusted to you; do not abandon the bound when danger closes
Take suffering freely to spare another, but never make a chain of their sacrifice

oathCatalog.theme: Sorrow, remembrance, and the duty of passage
conductClauses: Keep faith with the dead and with those they leave behind
Do not make sport of grief or profane a place of remembrance
Guide the departed toward rest; do not claim them for undeath

oathCatalog.theme: Liberty, the breaking of unjust bonds, and freedom guarded against a new tyranny
conductClauses: Break the bonds of the unjustly imprisoned, and do not turn liberation into license to abandon them
Resist every tyrant, including the one who would rule in freedom's name
Guard the newly freed from exploitation, for an open door is not yet a safe road

oathCatalog.theme: Stewardship, the burden of the crown, and sacrifice freely borne for those in your care
conductClauses: Bear the responsibility of command without treating those in your care as a means to your glory
Set the realm's need above personal gain, and spend your own strength before you spend another's
Never demand a burden you would not freely take upon yourself
